expectation: CD4 should be a membrane ring on a subset of cells: helper and regulatory T cells, with weaker monocytes and macrophages. In gut, scattered cells in the lamina propria and clustered in lymphoid aggregates, often on CD3E+ cells.
observed: A: yellow cells speckled through the mucosa and denser in the central lamina propria, with epithelium and lumen dark. B and C: mostly dark, with a few saturated blobs. D: one blob and some granular signal. E1: clear membrane rings in a dense aggregate, over CD3E+ cells in E3.
why: E1 shows crisp membrane rings on a subset of cells that overlie CD3E+ cells, and A shows cells in the lamina propria rather than uniform haze.
